stoppedHelp: Resolve them, then continue (or abort to put everything back).
revertDescription: A new commit on {branch} undoes "{subject}". The original stays in the history.
nothingToRevert: There was nothing to take back.
cherryPickDescription: The changes of "{subject}" again, as a new commit on {branch}.
resetPushed: Commits after it are on {remotes}: pushing then needs Overwrite.
resetDescription: {branch} moves back to this commit. Soft keeps later changes staged, mixed keeps them unstaged, hard discards them; your local changes are saved to Recently discarded.
resetHardDescription: The commits after {label} leave {branch}, and your local changes are replaced (saved first).
undoCommitDescription: "{subject}" leaves {branch}; its changes are staged again, ready to commit.
undoCommitPushed: It is on {remotes} already: pushing after this needs Overwrite.
mergeDescription: {branch} gets {name}'s commits: a fast-forward if possible, otherwise a merge commit.
abortDescription: The branch and files go back to before it started. Resolved conflicts are lost.
